  * All evidence lines verified accurate (E4 line 231, E5 lines 433–454, E6 lines 52–58, E7 lines 96–97, E8 line 29)
  * Plan is otherwise well-structured and actionable; 7/8 requirements fully met, 1 partial (Task 4 cross-service scope gap requires plan amendment before execution)
